title: Correctness: DO_SIGN and DO_AGREE reject KEY_PAIR keys
description: Trigger: KEY_GENERATE produces key_type=KEY_PAIR (fd.c:2192). Caller then issues DO_SIGN or DO_AGREE with that fd as key_fd. ioctl_do_sign (line 1206) and ioctl_do_agree (line 1398) both check key_type \!= CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PRIVATE and return -EBADF. The UAPI header says both ops accept 'key_type KEY_PRIVATE or KEY_PAIR'. So any key produced by KEY_GENERATE is permanently unusable for sign or agree. The fix (from pass1) correctly blocks KEY_PUBLIC and KEY_SYMMETRIC but overcorrects by blocking KEY_PAIR. The correct check is: (key_type \!= KEY_PRIVATE && key_type \!= KEY_PAIR).
